privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.who: Nordciel ("we", "us") is a software studio based in Ontario, Canada that publishes apps and games, including Pianotes. You can reach us at {email}.
privacy.collect: Our apps are designed to collect as little information as possible. Unless an app's store listing says otherwise:
privacy.collect1: We do not require an account and do not collect your name, email or contacts.
privacy.collect2: Settings and progress are stored on your device.
privacy.collect3: App stores (Google Play, Apple App Store, Roblox) may collect diagnostic and purchase data under their own privacy policies.
privacy.third: Where an app uses third-party services (for example analytics, crash reporting or ads), those services are listed in the app's store "Data safety" section and governed by their own privacy policies.
privacy.children: We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.
privacy.rights: Under Canadian privacy law (PIPEDA) you may ask what personal information we hold about you and request corrections or deletion by emailing {email}.
privacy.changes: We may update this policy. The latest version will always be available on this page.
